description: This file defines a JavaScript module named 'returnsService.js' that manages return requests in a front-end application. It provides functions for uploading proof images, creating return requests, listing all returns, retrieving a return by ID, and approving refunds. The service supports both mock-style local storage fallback and optional backend API calls, depending on environment configuration. It includes handling for file uploads, localStorage persistence, and mock logic for instant refunds under certain conditions.

methods.name: readLocal()
methods.description: Reads and parses return data from localStorage under the key 'ghub_returns_v1'. Handles errors and invalid data gracefully.

methods.name: writeLocal(returnsList)
methods.description: Serializes and stores the given list of returns into localStorage under the key 'ghub_returns_v1'.

methods.name: generateId()
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier for return entries using current timestamp and a random string.

methods.name: getApiBase()
methods.description: Determines the backend API base URL from environment variables or returns an empty string for mock mode.

methods.name: tryBackend(method, url, body, headers = {})
methods.description: Performs fetch requests to the backend API with specified method, URL, body, and headers, handling errors and fallback.

methods.name: uploadProof(orderId, itemId, file)
methods.description: Uploads a proof image for a return request; in mock mode creates a local object URL, otherwise POSTs multipart form data to backend.

methods.name: createReturn({ orderId, itemId, reason, description, photos = [] })
methods.description: Creates a return request, storing in localStorage in mock mode or sending data to backend. Supports auto-approval and refund for 'Damaged' reason with photos.

methods.name: listReturns()
methods.description: Lists all return requests, fetching from backend if available, or from local storage otherwise.

methods.name: getReturnById(id)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific return request by its ID, querying backend if possible, or filtering local storage.

methods.name: approveInstantRefund(id)
methods.description: Mocks instant approval and refunding of a return request; attempts backend approval if API available, else updates local data.
